liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Wharf Rat** (5 reviews): Wharf Rat coming out of space was so poor that people leaving talked about it as a new song; Wharf Rat starts messy with Jerry sounding lost, though this reviewer hears him trying on relistening [10][11][13][17][18]
- **Stagger Lee** (2 reviews): Stagger Lee was fiery, with Jerry deeply engaged; Stagger Lee has a nice jam at the end [9][19]
- **Feel Like a Stranger** (1 review): Opener was badly off-key, with Garcia seeming detached from the band, as if jamming along to a radio [9]
- **The Same Thing** (1 review): The Same Thing is played and sung very nicely [19]
- **Eternity** (1 other source): Security first approached the taper during Eternity, and the guard can be heard on tape [4]
- **Deal** (1 other source): During Deal the guard confiscated a Bob Dylan tape the taper had recorded earlier [4]

## The recordings

- **gd95-06-18.aud.2543.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 19 songs; 154 min; rated 2.23/5 by 64 [1]
- **gd1995-06-18.fob.nak300.stine.35213.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 154 min; rated 3.11/5 by 9 [3]
- **gd1995-06-18.fob-nak300-patched-13307.stine.92802.shnf**: source not stated; 18 songs; 154 min [4]
- **gd1995-06-18.145846.sony.ecm909a.sterry.beckwith.miller.sirmick.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 156 min [5]

## Around the show

- The band later mentioned that Wharf Rat moment in an interview not focused on this show [10]
- Extremely hot and humid, same as the other New Jersey show [11]
- Reviewer enjoyed the parking lot more than the music, finding the show weak overall [12]
- Giants Stadium had a great parking lot scene and was usually a good time [13]
- Jumbotron screens showed Garcia looking frail and sickly; fans left feeling he needed rest [14]
- A sad night at Giants Stadium, where it felt like the band's end was near [15]
- Taper Wally Stine had a hard time with security while taping [3]
- Sloppy at both ends, but the middle stretch has some of the strongest energy of the 1995 summer tour [9]
- Reviewer ranked it among the summer tour's best, alongside Pittsburgh and the early Riverport and Soldier Field nights [11]
- Judged much worse than the Soldier Field show [17]
- China Cat into Rider is called the best version of 1995 [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd95-06-18.aud.2543.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Jeff M.; source: Audience: Unknown Mics [1]. Also: Audience recording with unknown mics, taken to DAT then CDR, passed along via Jeff M [1]
- **gd1995-06-18.fob.nak300.stine.35213.flac16**: taped by Wally Stine; transferred by Wally Stine; source: nak 300's > Sony D7 > Dat [3]. Also: Front-of-board Nak 300 recording by Wally Stine, patched with another FOB made on an AKG and TEAC rig [3]
- **gd1995-06-18.fob-nak300-patched-13307.stine.92802.shnf**: taped by Wally Stine; transferred by Wally Stine; source: Nak 300's Hand Held (Arm still sore) into my Sony d7. [4]. Also: Patched using a source recorded on two TEAC decks with AKG mics [4]
- **gd1995-06-18.145846.sony.ecm909a.sterry.beckwith.miller.sirmick.flac16**: taped by George Sterry; transferred by Charlie Miller and SIRMick and David Beckwith; source: Source: Sony ECM-909A > Sony WM-D3 > Cassette Master (Maxell XL-II90) - Recorded by George Sterry [5]. Also: Patched from shnid 2543: final 49 seconds of Stagger Lee and first 20 seconds of China Cat Sunflower [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1995-06-19 Giants Stadium, East Rutherford, NJ, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1995-06-19-giants-stadium-east-rutherford-nj-usa/) [22]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1995-06-18 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1995-06-18-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [23]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Giants Stadium - June 19, 1995](https://www.dead.net/show/june-19-1995) [24]
